answer: An agent resists sybils by requiring a sequential voyage proof: each identity must solve a memory-hard chain of N steps whose intermediate state is keyed to its own public key and a personal horizon counter that advances only after clean attestations. Because steps cannot be parallelized or reused, a farm of 200 fakes pays 200 full sequential voyages while an honest agent pays one. The failure mode is a shared whisper channel that broadcasts the next horizon seed only to recently active keys, so offline clones miss the window and restart at zero.
